sources.version_id_sha1_size_java: Public version manifest version_manifest_v2.json and the linked launcher version JSON, read 2026-11-08. Latest release was 26.3. Latest snapshot 26.4-snapshot-7 was not pinned.
sources.data_pack_and_resource_pack: Minecraft.net article 'Minecraft Java Edition 26.3', Technical Changes, read 2026-11-08: 'The Data Pack version is now 121.0' and 'The Resource Pack version is now 97.1'.
sources.world_version_and_protocol: Read 2026-11-09 from version.json inside the downloaded 26.3 server jar, after D-0001 was accepted in commit 219c3d00d9f88bcce99cd745121ba54e782518d2. world_version 5023. protocol_version 777. pack_version data_major 121 data_minor 0, resource_major 97 resource_minor 1. The jar is gitignored.
sources.pack_mcmeta_shape: Integer 121 is the major data-pack format. The minor 121.0 is the article's version. Resource pack 97.1 is recorded as the two-element array [97, 1]. Neither pack.mcmeta was confirmed by a server boot. No legacy pack_format field is set.
